## Load a model
A model is a folder with `config.json`, `model.safetensors` and `manifest.json`.
PyMC Labs publishes models as profiles of a Hugging Face Hub repository, and any
of them loads with one call:

```python
from pymc_mktfm import from_pretrained

model = from_pretrained("pymc-labs/mfm", profile="river-1")
```

Pin `revision=` to a full commit for reproducible results. See
[Load and share models](../guide/models-hub.qmd) for local folders, caches and
publishing your own.
